Start with one projection. Choose exactly two more observations; a repeat consumes a choice without adding unique information.
Each query acts on the original source. The two turns are separate observations; no combined turn is available.
Watch preserves the sealed choice order and repeats. Static shows the same three occurrence cards together.
Information parity is checked only at completed routes. Timing, agency, memory demand and pixels are not assumed equal.
